citation: Classified advertisement, 'To rent—nicely furnished rooms; good location; moderate prices. 2101 Indiana-av.'. Chicago Daily Tribune, 5 June 1905 (vol. 64 no. 133).
author: Chicago Daily Tribune
locator: The issue's OCR text (per_chicago-daily-tribune_1905-06-05_64_133), the classified columns; the OCR runs neighbouring advertisements together, so only the words quoted in the note are read from it.
rights_note: A United States newspaper of 1905; public domain.
access_notes: Found by the Internet Archive's full-text search for the street address and read in the issue's OCR text for T-3013 on 2026-10-23; the page image was not consulted.
note: Furnished rooms let at 2101 Indiana Avenue in June 1905, and in 1906-1907 a Mrs. Burnett advertises from the address: the corner was a lodging house, not a garage, after 1904.
what_it_supplies: that 2101 Indiana Avenue was a lodging house in 1905
what_it_does_not_supply: the building's form, storeys, material or outline
